verdict.rationale: Sentry's official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues, and manage projects through natural language. In-product, Seer Agent answers free-form questions about your application's telemetry. A one-command setup also teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok to install and configure Sentry. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice; documentation of the range of actions possible natively in the product beyond Q&A (natural-language changes to alerts or dashboards are not evidenced).
